notice: From eqlwiki's Special AAs table; parts are datamined and unverified until Kunark is live.

completionist.passive: This passive ability increases the damage of your melee by 1%. You can raise your rank in this ability by completing all Class Reincarnations.

entries.name: Warrior
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces incoming melee damage by 2%.
entries.activeText: 4 primary-hand combat rounds on everything within 40 ft

entries.name: Paladin
entries.passive: This passive ability increases the effectiveness of incoming instant duration healing spells by 3%.
entries.activeText: Heals a friendly target, or an enemy's target, for 50% of max HP (range 100). Not in the description: a recourse that appears to give you 10% of your mana, capped at 1M

entries.name: Shadow Knight
entries.passive: This passive ability increases the damage of your casted instant duration lifetap spells by 3%.
entries.activeText: Spends 50% of current HP and deals 100% of it as damage (range 200)

entries.name: Monk
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your chance to dodge by 2%.
entries.activeText: Cures all detrimental effects and heals 50% of max HP

entries.name: Rogue
entries.passive: This passive ability increases the damage of activated skill abilities by 3%. This applies to Backstab, Bash, Cleave, Dragon Punch, Eagle Strike, Flying Kick, Frenzy, Kick, Reave, Round Kick, Smite, and Tiger Claw.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your chance to hit by 3%.
entries.activeText: Double hit chance and 100% strikethrough for 24s

entries.name: Bard
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your movement speed by 3%.
entries.activeText: Escape from NPCs up to 5 levels above you, become last on rampage lists, and gain permanent invisibility (Evader's Invisibility)

entries.name: Beastlord
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces your pet's attack delay by 3%

entries.name: Berserker
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces your endurance costs by 3%.
entries.activeText: Gives a Blood Rune equal to 66% of your missing HP, which can go over your cap

entries.name: Cleric
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the mana cost of all healing spells by 2%.
entries.activeText: +50% damage and -50% cast time on any Cleric/Paladin-usable DD

entries.name: Druid
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the cast time of all spells by 2%.
entries.activeText: +100% damage on your thorn damage shields for 30s

entries.name: Shaman
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the mana cost of all beneficial spells that do not contain a heal component by 3%.
entries.activeText: If your DoTs left on the target would deal more than its remaining HP, they all land at once (range 200)

entries.name: Enchanter
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the mana cost of any non-damaging detrimental spell by 3%.

entries.name: Wizard
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the mana cost of direct damage spells by 2%.
entries.activeText: Twincasts your next 2 DD spells (2 min window)

entries.name: Magician
entries.passive: This passive ability increases the damage of your pets by 3%
entries.activeText: Fully restores pet HP, mana and endurance and cures it (range 300)

entries.name: Necromancer
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces the cost of damage over time spells by 2%.
entries.activeText: Spells cost HP instead of mana for 30s

entries.name: Barbarian
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces incoming cold damage by 3%.

entries.name: Dark Elf
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces incoming fire damage by 3%.

entries.name: Dwarf
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your chance to resist fear spells by 10%.

entries.name: Erudite
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your mana regeneration by 2.

entries.name: Froglok
entries.passive: This passive ability will increase your jump power by 10% and your hitpoint regeneration by 1.

entries.name: Gnome
entries.passive: This passive ability grants you an additional 10% chance to resist charm and mesmerization spells.

entries.name: Half Dark Elf
entries.passive: This passive ability will increase the range of your tracking and map awareness by 10%.

entries.name: Half Elf
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your base stat caps and all resists by 3.

entries.name: Halfling
entries.passive: This passive ability will mitigate the effects of any negative movement speed effect by 15%.

entries.name: High Elf
entries.passive: This passive ability reduces incoming magic damage by 3%.

entries.name: Human
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your base stat caps by 5.

entries.name: Iksar
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your hitpoint regeneration by 2 and your base armor class by 5.

entries.name: Kerran
entries.passive: This passive ability will increase your endurance regeneration by 2 and grants an additional 10 points to your Safe Fall skill.

entries.name: Ogre
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your chance to resist any stun by 10%.

entries.name: Troll
entries.passive: This passive ability increases your hitpoint regeneration by 3.

entries.name: Wood Elf
entries.passive: This passive ability will increase the range of your spells and ranged attacks by 10 units.
